issues.title: Imported value models end up with layers and components active:false; validate_value_model_links reports 10 of 10 served and the result changes on identical content
Validation tools should return a machine-readable verdict (structuredContent + outputSchema)
Decomposer: MappingArtifacts for single-artifact groups missing 'implements' edges
UI handlers silently drop schema-valid artifact content (insight analyses shows only competitors); no render tests tied to epf-canonical
import: two files map to artifact roadmap_recipe and which one wins changes from run to run
North Star page drops values, conflicts, boundaries and history: the handler reads flat keys from a payload wrapped in north_star
